current_bounded_findings: Storage ownership must be explicit for a shared groundwater state.
Correct repartition of one physical storage is invariant; duplicate storage has a predictable signature.
A true finite-resistance q-link is physically distinct from a shared-state h-link and from a storage tangent.
A shared groundwater head is not necessarily a complete unsaturated-column state.
Head-dependent ET and drain slopes are sink responses, not storage coefficients.
A local tangent can reproduce nonlinear integrated storage without itself being the physical storage volume.
Repeated external reanchoring inside one MODFLOW prepared solve can exhibit history-dependent convergence behavior even when the same affine term converges from a fresh prepared solve.
